The '''GXR-7 Sentinel''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Several were aboard the [[Thranta-class corvette]] ''[[Brentaal Star]]'' during an [[Attack on the Brentaal Star|attack]] by the Imperial [[Gage-class transport]] ''[[Black Talon]]'' and were destroyed by an Imperial boarding party.<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
GXR-7 Sentinels appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as enemies during the "Black Talon" flashpoint.
